adaptability.name: Adaptability
adaptability.desc: Boosts the power of moves of the same type as the Pokémon by 100% instead of 50%.

aerilate.name: Aerilate
aerilate.desc: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

analytic.name: Analytic
analytic.desc: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's moves by 30% when the Pokémon is the last to move that turn.

anger point.name: Anger Point
anger point.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat to its sixth stage when the Pokémon takes a critical hit.

armor tail.name: Armor Tail
armor tail.desc: Opponents are unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

aroma veil.name: Aroma Veil
aroma veil.desc: The Pokémon and its allies cannot gain the Infatuated, Taunted, Move Disabled, Healing Prevented, or Encore statuses.

battle armor.name: Battle Armor
battle armor.desc: Attacks landed on the Pokémon will never be critical hits.

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat by 1 stage when an attack causes its HP to drop to 1/2 or less of its max.

blaze.name: Blaze
blaze.desc: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Fire-type moves by 50% when its HP drops to 1/3 or less of its max.

bulletproof.name: Bulletproof
bulletproof.desc: The Pokémon is immune to ball and bomb moves.

cheek pouch.name: Cheek Pouch
cheek pouch.desc: The Pokémon has 1/3 of its max HP restored when it eats a Berry, in addition to the Berry's usual effect.

chlorophyll.name: Chlorophyll
chlorophyll.desc: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat in harsh sunlight.

clear body.name: Clear Body
clear body.desc: The Pokémon's stats cannot be lowered by other Pokémon's moves or Abilities.

competitive.name: Competitive
competitive.desc: When the Pokémon has any of its stats lowered by an opponent, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted by 2 stages.

compound eyes.name: Compound Eyes
compound eyes.desc: Boosts the accuracy of the Pokémon's moves by 30%.

contrary.name: Contrary
contrary.desc: Reverses any stat changes affecting the Pokémon so that attempts to boost its stats instead lower them—and attempts to lower its stats will boost them.

corrosion.name: Corrosion
corrosion.desc: The Pokémon can poison or badly poison targets even if they're Steel or Poison types.

cud chew.name: Cud Chew
cud chew.desc: If the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will eat that same Berry once more at the end of the next turn.

curious medicine.name: Curious Medicine
curious medicine.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it removes all stat changes from its allies.

cursed body.name: Cursed Body
cursed body.desc: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, the attacker has a 30% chance of gaining the Move Disabled status for 4 turns.

cute charm.name: Cute Charm
cute charm.desc: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 30% chance of gaining the Infatuated status if of opposite gender.

damp.name: Damp
damp.desc: All Pokémon become unable to use explosive moves. Explosive Abilities also fail to trigger.

defiant.name: Defiant
defiant.desc: When the Pokémon has any of its stats lowered by an opponent, its Attack stat is boosted by 2 stages.

disguise.name: Disguise
disguise.desc: When the Pokémon is in its Disguised Form and would take damage from a move, it loses 1/8 of its max HP instead of taking the damage, then changes into its Busted Form.

dragonize.name: Dragonize
dragonize.desc: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

drizzle.name: Drizzle
drizzle.desc: Summons rain for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle.

drought.name: Drought
drought.desc: Summons harsh sunlight for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle.

dry skin.name: Dry Skin
dry skin.desc: Water-type moves restore 1/4 of max HP. Fire-type moves deal 25% more damage. Restores 1/8 max HP in rain, loses 1/8 in harsh sunlight.

early bird.name: Early Bird
early bird.desc: The Pokémon awakens from sleep twice as fast as other Pokémon.

earth eater.name: Earth Eater
earth eater.desc: Ground-type moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they restore 1/4 of its max HP.

effect spore.name: Effect Spore
effect spore.desc: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 30% chance of being poisoned, paralyzed, or put to sleep.

electric surge.name: Electric Surge
electric surge.desc: Turns the entire field into Electric Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle.

electromorphosis.name: Electromorphosis
electromorphosis.desc: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it gains the Electric Boost status.

fairy aura.name: Fairy Aura
fairy aura.desc: Boosts the power of the Fairy-type moves of all Pokémon on the field by 33%.

filter.name: Filter
filter.desc: Reduces the damage the Pokémon takes from supereffective moves by 25%.

flame body.name: Flame Body
flame body.desc: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 30% chance of being burned.

flash fire.name: Flash Fire
flash fire.desc: Fire-type moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they give the Pokémon the Flash Fire status.

flower veil.name: Flower Veil
flower veil.desc: Grass-type allies are immune to status conditions and cannot have their stats lowered.

fluffy.name: Fluffy
fluffy.desc: Halves the damage the Pokémon takes from contact moves, but doubles the damage taken from Fire-type moves.

forecast.name: Forecast
forecast.desc: The Pokémon transforms with the weather to change its type to Water, Fire, or Ice.

friend guard.name: Friend Guard
friend guard.desc: Reduces the damage allies take by 25%.

frisk.name: Frisk
frisk.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it identifies opponents' held items.

fur coat.name: Fur Coat
fur coat.desc: Halves the damage the Pokémon takes from physical moves.

gale wings.name: Gale Wings
gale wings.desc: Increases the priority of the Pokémon's Flying-type moves by 1 stage while its HP is full.

gluttony.name: Gluttony
gluttony.desc: If the Pokémon is holding a Berry to be eaten at 1/4 HP or less, it will instead eat the Berry at 1/2 HP or less.

good as gold.name: Good as Gold
good as gold.desc: The Pokémon is immune to status moves used by other Pokémon.

gooey.name: Gooey
gooey.desc: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker's Speed stat is lowered by 1 stage.

guts.name: Guts
guts.desc: When the Pokémon has a status condition, its Attack stat is boosted by 50%. Being burned does not halve the damage of its physical moves.

harvest.name: Harvest
harvest.desc: If the Pokémon has used a Berry, it has a 50% chance of creating another one at the end of every turn. Guaranteed in harsh sunlight.

healer.name: Healer
healer.desc: The Pokémon has a 50% chance of curing the status conditions of its allies at the end of every turn.

heatproof.name: Heatproof
heatproof.desc: Halves the damage the Pokémon takes from Fire-type moves and from being burned.

hospitality.name: Hospitality
hospitality.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it restores 1/4 of its ally's max HP.

huge power.name: Huge Power
huge power.desc: Doubles the power of the Pokémon's physical moves.

hunger switch.name: Hunger Switch
hunger switch.desc: The Pokémon alternates between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode at the end of every turn.

hustle.name: Hustle
hustle.desc: When the Pokémon uses physical moves, its Attack stat is boosted by 50%, but its accuracy is lowered by 20%.

hyper cutter.name: Hyper Cutter
hyper cutter.desc: The Pokémon's Attack stat cannot be lowered by other Pokémon's moves or Abilities.

ice body.name: Ice Body
ice body.desc: The Pokémon has 1/16 of its max HP restored at the end of every turn in snow.

illuminate.name: Illuminate
illuminate.desc: The Pokémon ignores changes to targets' evasiveness and its accuracy cannot be lowered.

illusion.name: Illusion
illusion.desc: The Pokémon enters battle disguised as the last Pokémon in its party. It reverts to its usual appearance when it takes damage from a move.

immunity.name: Immunity
immunity.desc: The Pokémon cannot be poisoned or badly poisoned.

imposter.name: Imposter
imposter.desc: The Pokémon transforms into the Pokémon in front of it. It also copies all of that Pokémon's stats apart from its HP.

infiltrator.name: Infiltrator
infiltrator.desc: When using its moves, the Pokémon ignores the effects of targets' Light Screen, Reflect, Aurora Veil, Safeguard, and substitutes.

innards out.name: Innards Out
innards out.desc: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move that knocks it out, it deals the same amount of damage to the attacker.

inner focus.name: Inner Focus
inner focus.desc: The Pokémon never flinches when attacked and is unaffected by Intimidate.

insomnia.name: Insomnia
insomnia.desc: The Pokémon cannot become drowsy or be put to sleep.

intimidate.name: Intimidate
intimidate.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it lowers the Attack stats of opponents by 1 stage.

iron fist.name: Iron Fist
iron fist.desc: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's punching moves by 20%.

justified.name: Justified
justified.desc: When the Pokémon takes damage from a Dark-type move, its Attack stat is boosted by 1 stage.

keen eye.name: Keen Eye
keen eye.desc: The Pokémon ignores changes to targets' evasiveness and its accuracy cannot be lowered.

leaf guard.name: Leaf Guard
leaf guard.desc: The Pokémon is immune to status conditions in harsh sunlight.

levitate.name: Levitate
levitate.desc: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as the Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web statuses.

lightning rod.name: Lightning Rod
lightning rod.desc: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. These moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they boost its Sp. Atk stat by 1 stage.

liquid voice.name: Liquid Voice
liquid voice.desc: The Pokémon's sound-based moves become Water-type moves.

long reach.name: Long Reach
long reach.desc: None of the moves used by the Pokémon are considered contact moves.

magic bounce.name: Magic Bounce
magic bounce.desc: Instead of being affected by other Pokémon's status moves, the Pokémon bounces them back at the user.

magic guard.name: Magic Guard
magic guard.desc: The Pokémon takes damage only from attacks.

magician.name: Magician
magician.desc: If the Pokémon is not already holding an item, it will steal the held item from targets it deals damage to with its moves.

marvel scale.name: Marvel Scale
marvel scale.desc: When the Pokémon has a status condition, its Defense stat is boosted by 50%.

mega launcher.name: Mega Launcher
mega launcher.desc: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's pulse moves by 50%.

mega sol.name: Mega Sol
mega sol.desc: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.

merciless.name: Merciless
merciless.desc: The Pokémon's attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned or badly poisoned.

mimicry.name: Mimicry
mimicry.desc: The Pokémon's type changes depending on the terrain.

mirror armor.name: Mirror Armor
mirror armor.desc: Instead of being affected by stat-lowering effects, the Pokémon bounces them back at whichever Pokémon caused them.

mold breaker.name: Mold Breaker
mold breaker.desc: The Pokémon's moves are unaffected by the Ability of the target (with certain exceptions).

moody.name: Moody
moody.desc: At the end of every turn, one of the Pokémon's stats will be boosted by 2 stages, but another will be lowered by 1 stage.

motor drive.name: Motor Drive
motor drive.desc: Electric-type moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they boost its Speed stat by 1 stage.

moxie.name: Moxie
moxie.desc: When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, its Attack stat is boosted by 1 stage.

multiscale.name: Multiscale
multiscale.desc: Halves the damage the Pokémon takes while its HP is full.

mummy.name: Mummy
mummy.desc: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has its Ability changed to Mummy.

natural cure.name: Natural Cure
natural cure.desc: The Pokémon's status conditions are cured when it switches out of battle.

no guard.name: No Guard
no guard.desc: The accuracy of moves used both by and against the Pokémon becomes 100%.

oblivious.name: Oblivious
oblivious.desc: The Pokémon cannot gain the Infatuated or Taunted statuses and is unaffected by Intimidate.

opportunist.name: Opportunist
opportunist.desc: When an opponent's stats are boosted, the Pokémon boosts its own stats in the exact same way.

overcoat.name: Overcoat
overcoat.desc: The Pokémon takes no damage from sandstorms and is immune to moves and Abilities involving powder.

overgrow.name: Overgrow
overgrow.desc: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Grass-type moves by 50% when its HP drops to 1/3 or less of its max.

own tempo.name: Own Tempo
own tempo.desc: The Pokémon cannot become confused and is unaffected by Intimidate.

parental bond.name: Parental Bond
parental bond.desc: The parent and child attack one after the other. The power of the child's attacks is 1/4 of those of the parent.

pickpocket.name: Pickpocket
pickpocket.desc: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, it will steal the held item of the attacker if it is not already holding an item.

pickup.name: Pickup
pickup.desc: If the Pokémon is not already holding an item, at the end of the turn it will pick up an item that was consumed by another Pokémon.

piercing drill.name: Piercing Drill
piercing drill.desc: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage.

pixilate.name: Pixilate
pixilate.desc: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

plus.name: Plus
plus.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat by 50% if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.

poison heal.name: Poison Heal
poison heal.desc: If poisoned or badly poisoned, the Pokémon has 1/8 of its max HP restored at the end of every turn instead of losing HP.

poison point.name: Poison Point
poison point.desc: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 30% chance of being poisoned.

poison touch.name: Poison Touch
poison touch.desc: When the Pokémon hits a target with a contact move, the target has a 30% chance of being poisoned.

prankster.name: Prankster
prankster.desc: Increases the priority of the Pokémon's status moves by 1 stage.

pressure.name: Pressure
pressure.desc: Causes opponents to expend 1 more PP when using moves against the Pokémon.

protean.name: Protean
protean.desc: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use. This works only once per time the Pokémon enters battle.

pure power.name: Pure Power
pure power.desc: Doubles the power of the Pokémon's physical moves.

purifying salt.name: Purifying Salt
purifying salt.desc: Halves the damage the Pokémon takes from Ghost-type moves. The Pokémon is immune to status conditions.

queenly majesty.name: Queenly Majesty
queenly majesty.desc: Opponents are unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

quick draw.name: Quick Draw
quick draw.desc: The Pokémon's moves have a 30% chance of going first among moves of the same priority.

quick feet.name: Quick Feet
quick feet.desc: When the Pokémon has a status condition, its Speed stat is boosted by 50%. Being paralyzed does not lower the Pokémon's Speed stat.

rain dish.name: Rain Dish
rain dish.desc: The Pokémon has 1/16 of its max HP restored at the end of every turn in rain.

receiver.name: receiver
receiver.desc: The Pokémon changes its Ability to match that of a defeated ally.

reckless.name: Reckless
reckless.desc: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's moves by 20% if they have recoil or crash damage.

refrigerate.name: Refrigerate
refrigerate.desc: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

regenerator.name: Regenerator
regenerator.desc: The Pokémon has 1/3 of its max HP restored when it switches out of battle.

ripen.name: Ripen
ripen.desc: Doubles the effects of Berries eaten by the Pokémon.

rivalry.name: Rivalry
rivalry.desc: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's moves by 25% against targets of the same gender, and lowers it by 25% against targets of the opposite gender.

rock head.name: Rock Head
rock head.desc: The Pokémon will not lose HP due to recoil damage from its moves.

rough skin.name: Rough Skin
rough skin.desc: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker takes damage equal to 1/8 of its max HP.

sand force.name: Sand Force
sand force.desc: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Rock-, Ground-, and Steel-type moves by 30% in a sandstorm.

sand rush.name: Sand Rush
sand rush.desc: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat in a sandstorm.

sand stream.name: Sand Stream
sand stream.desc: Summons a sandstorm for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle.

sand veil.name: Sand Veil
sand veil.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness by 25% in a sandstorm.

sap sipper.name: Sap Sipper
sap sipper.desc: Grass-type moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they boost its Attack stat by 1 stage.

scrappy.name: Scrappy
scrappy.desc: The Pokémon can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.

screen cleaner.name: Screen Cleaner
screen cleaner.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it removes the Light Screen, Reflect, and Aurora Veil statuses.

shadow tag.name: Shadow Tag
shadow tag.desc: Opponents cannot be switched out of battle.

sharpness.name: Sharpness
sharpness.desc: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's slicing moves by 50%.

shed skin.name: Shed Skin
shed skin.desc: The Pokémon has a 30% chance of curing its own status conditions at the end of every turn.

sheer force.name: Sheer Force
sheer force.desc: The Pokémon's moves lose their additional effects, but the power of those moves will be boosted by 30%.

shell armor.name: Shell Armor
shell armor.desc: Attacks landed on the Pokémon will never be critical hits.

shield dust.name: Shield Dust
shield dust.desc: The Pokémon is immune to additional effects from attacks.

skill link.name: Skill Link
skill link.desc: The Pokémon's multistrike moves always hit the maximum number of times.

slush rush.name: Slush Rush
slush rush.desc: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat in snow.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.desc: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's critical hits by 125% instead of 50%.

snow cloak.name: Snow Cloak
snow cloak.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness by 25% in snow.

snow warning.name: Snow Warning
snow warning.desc: Summons snow for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle.

solar power.name: Solar Power
solar power.desc: In harsh sunlight, the Pokémon's Sp. Atk stat is boosted by 50%, but it loses 1/8 of its max HP at the end of every turn.

solid rock.name: Solid Rock
solid rock.desc: Reduces the damage the Pokémon takes from supereffective moves by 25%.

soundproof.name: Soundproof
soundproof.desc: The Pokémon is immune to sound-based moves.

speed boost.name: Speed Boost
speed boost.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat by 1 stage at the end of every turn.

spicy spray.name: Spicy Spray
spicy spray.desc: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.

stalwart.name: Stalwart
stalwart.desc: The Pokémon ignores the effects of Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

stamina.name: Stamina
stamina.desc: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, its Defense stat is boosted by 1 stage.

stance change.name: Stance Change
stance change.desc: The Pokémon changes into its Blade Forme when it attacks and changes into its Shield Forme when it uses the move King's Shield.

static.name: Static
static.desc: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, the attacker has a 30% chance of being paralyzed.

steadfast.name: Steadfast
steadfast.desc: When the Pokémon flinches, its Speed stat is boosted by 1 stage.

strong jaw.name: Strong Jaw
strong jaw.desc: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's biting moves by 50%.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.desc: If the Pokémon has full HP and takes damage from a move that would knock it out in one hit, it will endure the hit with 1 HP. The Pokémon is also immune to one-hit KO moves.

super luck.name: Super Luck
super luck.desc: The Pokémon has a 1-stage Critical-Hit Ratio Boost.

supersweet syrup.name: Supersweet Syrup
supersweet syrup.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, opponents' evasiveness is lowered by 1 stage. Triggered only once per battle.

supreme overlord.name: Supreme Overlord
supreme overlord.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the power of its moves is boosted by 10% for each Pokémon in its party that has been defeated. Max boost is 50%.

surge surfer.name: Surge Surfer
surge surfer.desc: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat on Electric Terrain.

swarm.name: Swarm
swarm.desc: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Bug-type moves by 50% when its HP drops to 1/3 or less of its max.

sweet veil.name: Sweet Veil
sweet veil.desc: The Pokémon and its allies cannot become drowsy or be put to sleep.

swift swim.name: Swift Swim
swift swim.desc: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat in rain.

symbiosis.name: Symbiosis
symbiosis.desc: When an ally consumes an item, the Pokémon gives its own held item to that ally.

synchronize.name: Synchronize
synchronize.desc: If the Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, poisoned, or badly poisoned by another Pokémon's move or Ability, that Pokémon will also be inflicted with the same status condition.

tangled feet.name: Tangled Feet
tangled feet.desc: Doubles the Pokémon's evasiveness if it is confused.

technician.name: Technician
technician.desc: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's moves by 50% if their power is 60 or less.

telepathy.name: Telepathy
telepathy.desc: The Pokémon dodges attacks from its allies.

thick fat.name: Thick Fat
thick fat.desc: Halves the damage the Pokémon takes from Fire- and Ice-type moves.

torrent.name: Torrent
torrent.desc: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Water-type moves by 50% when its HP drops to 1/3 or less of its max.

tough claws.name: Tough Claws
tough claws.desc: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's contact moves by 30%.

toxic debris.name: Toxic Debris
toxic debris.desc: When the Pokémon takes damage from a physical move, it gives the opponent's side the Toxic Spikes status.

trace.name: Trace
trace.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it changes its Ability to match that of an opponent.

unaware.name: Unaware
unaware.desc: The Pokémon ignores the target's stat changes when attacking, and ignores the attacker's stat changes when being attacked.

unburden.name: Unburden
unburden.desc: Doubles the Pokémon's Speed stat when its held item is consumed or lost.

unnerve.name: Unnerve
unnerve.desc: Makes opponents unable to eat Berries.

unseen fist.name: Unseen Fist
unseen fist.desc: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal.

vital spirit.name: Vital Spirit
vital spirit.desc: The Pokémon cannot become drowsy or be put to sleep.

volt absorb.name: Volt Absorb
volt absorb.desc: Electric-type moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they restore 1/4 of its max HP.

wandering spirit.name: Wandering Spirit
wandering spirit.desc: When the Pokémon is hit by a contact move, it swaps Abilities with the attacker.

water absorb.name: Water Absorb
water absorb.desc: Water-type moves do not work on the Pokémon. Instead, they restore 1/4 of its max HP.

water bubble.name: Water Bubble
water bubble.desc: Halves the damage the Pokémon takes from Fire-type moves and doubles the power of its Water-type moves. The Pokémon cannot be burned.

weak armor.name: Weak Armor
weak armor.desc: When the Pokémon takes damage from a physical move, its Defense is lowered by 1 stage, but its Speed is boosted by 2 stages.

white smoke.name: White Smoke
white smoke.desc: The Pokémon's stats cannot be lowered by other Pokémon's moves or Abilities.

zero to hero.name: Zero to Hero
zero to hero.desc: The Pokémon changes into its Hero Form when it switches out of battle.
